title: Unary halting with one-bit advice
statement: For every machine representation scheme $c$, the unary halting language associated with $c$ is decidable in time $c_0(n+1)$ with advice of length exactly one bit, for some constant $c_0\in\mathbb{N}$. Here the advice may depend on the input length, and the decision machine receives the paired encoding of the input and that advice.
hypotheses_covered: time bound is a constant multiple of $n+1$
advice length is exactly one bit at every input length
the advice string may depend on input length
